title: PredictNow
tagline: PredictNow allows anyone, with or without a crypto wallet, to predict sports tournaments such as World Cup 2022 and obtain a dynamic NFT that updates on each outcome powered by Open AI.
description: This app allow for transparency and easy access to prediction brackets for events like FIFA World Cup, NBA Playoffs, NHL Playoffs, NCAA March Madness. It assigns a Dynamic NFT to each prediction, which updates after each outcome. This assigns significant value to each prediction, specifically the one that predicted all outcomes correctly. The most accurate predictions can be transacted and auctioned off for monetary award. Have you previously predicted a bracket correctly? Well now, you can prove it and have a non fungible token to go with it. The app is built using SDKs that leverage the latest ERC 4337 protocol for account abstraction allowing for anyone in the world to predict the bracket via email, social login, etc. Moreover, OpenAI is used to generate the NFTs after each outcome, making it unique and valuable. By having predictions on the blockchain, third party developers can easily build on top of them, for example, predicting future tournaments or events.
how_its_made:
The ERC 4337 protocol is fairly new and it was a bit challenging to build upon it, learning new APIs, took me a while to realize the full potential.
All technologies used are bleeding edge so was hard to debug whether SDK is broken or own code, often times SDK was broken.
